title: Jean Oh
text:
About

I am an Assistant Professor of Organization Theory and Entrepreneurship at the Tepper School of Business, Carnegie Mellon University. I study the role of entrepreneurship in society, specifically how and when it operates as a channel for upward mobility and as a solution to social problems. My work has been published in peer-reviewed academic journals including Management Science, PNAS, and Academy of Management Discoveries, and has been covered by Harvard Business Review, Forbes, TechCrunch, and Scientific American.

I received my PhD in Management at Columbia Business School, MS in Strategy and BBA from Seoul National University. I grew up in Upstate New York and Seoul, Korea, and currently live in Pittsburgh. When I am not doing research, I enjoy rowing and spending time with my dog Ravioli.

title: Plan: Convert Paper Entries to Markdown Fenced Divs
Plan: Convert Paper Entries to Markdown Fenced Divs
text:
Adding a new paper currently requires typing ~8 lines of HTML with four CSS class names to remember (paper-title, paper-authors, paper-venue, paper-links). The goal is to let the user write papers in plain Markdown with standard formatting (**bold**, *italic*, [link](url)), wrapped in a single ::: paper / ::: fenced div block.
The page’s structural layout (two-column sidebar) must stay as raw HTML — there is no Markdown equivalent. Only the paper entries change.

title: Plan: Convert Paper Entries to Markdown Fenced Divs
text:
index.qmd — split the single {=html} block; papers become fenced divs
styles.css — replace .paper-title / .paper-authors / .paper-venue / .paper-links selectors with :nth-child equivalents
nav-active.html — update dot-separator JS (no longer uses .paper-links class)
_quarto.yml — add anchor-sections: false
